dashboard:herdr-core.summary: Follow factory status, resources, estimated cost and alerts in the Herdr app.
dashboard:herdr-core.use_when: Watch active goals, machine capacity and requests for attention from your Mac.

plugin:hivemill.summary: Set up a self-hosted Hivemill factory with the guided installer.
plugin:hivemill.use_when: Install the factory on a fresh Debian or Ubuntu host with a logged-in Claude Code.
plugin:hivemill.requirements: A fresh Debian or Ubuntu host and a logged-in Claude Code. The installer guide documents the remaining dependencies.

plugin:hivemill-spend.summary: Inspect Claude token usage and configure worker context limits.
plugin:hivemill-spend.use_when: Investigate costly sessions or reduce oversized worker contexts on a factory host.
plugin:hivemill-spend.requirements: Claude Code and access to the local Claude session data you want to inspect.

role:boss.summary: Turn requests into goals and keep the owner informed.
role:boss.use_when: Give the factory owner one point of contact for goals, progress and decisions.

role:cleaner.summary: Keep factory workspaces tidy through scoped housekeeping tasks.
role:cleaner.use_when: Assign routine workspace maintenance with explicit limits and checks.

role:coder.summary: Implement a scoped task, open a pull request and address review findings.
role:coder.use_when: Assign an implementation task with clear acceptance criteria and a separate review path.

role:director.summary: Coordinate the factory and assign goals to team leads.
role:director.use_when: Staff and coordinate work across multiple goals in a Hivemill factory.

role:evaluator.summary: Run an evaluation task inside a controlled sandbox.
role:evaluator.use_when: Evaluate an agent on a bounded task without granting production access.

role:judge.summary: Apply the project’s merge policy to a checked pull request.
role:judge.use_when: Keep the merge decision separate from implementation, review and QA.

role:lead.summary: Plan tasks and coordinate delivery of one goal.
role:lead.use_when: Break a goal into scoped tasks and follow the team’s progress.

role:pm.summary: Turn a request into requirements, acceptance criteria and a plan.
role:pm.use_when: Clarify what should be built and how the team will know it works.

role:qa.summary: Test a change against its acceptance criteria and record results.
role:qa.use_when: Verify a pull request independently from the agent that implemented it.

role:researcher.summary: Investigate one question and produce an evidence-backed report.
role:researcher.use_when: Resolve a bounded technical question before committing to an implementation.

role:retro.summary: Review rejected work and recommend process improvements.
role:retro.use_when: Look for recurring causes in rejected work without changing the active workflow automatically.

role:reviewer.summary: Review a pull request against its task and record findings.
role:reviewer.use_when: Check a proposed change independently before the merge decision.

role:scout.summary: Assess candidate skills through read-only research.
role:scout.use_when: Evaluate a potentially useful skill before adding it to the factory.

role:staff-engineer.summary: Provide technical advice on a specific engineering decision.
role:staff-engineer.use_when: Get a second technical perspective on architecture or a difficult implementation question.

skill:hivemill-spend/agent-context-limit.summary: Limit worker context while preserving a larger context for the coordinating agent.
skill:hivemill-spend/agent-context-limit.use_when: Reduce unnecessary context growth across worker sessions on a factory host.
skill:hivemill-spend/agent-context-limit.requirements: Claude Code and the hivemill-spend plugin on the host where worker settings will be configured.

skill:hivemill-spend/token-spend-audit.summary: Find costly Claude sessions and practical ways to reduce token use.
skill:hivemill-spend/token-spend-audit.use_when: Understand which models, sessions and context patterns drive estimated Claude spend.
skill:hivemill-spend/token-spend-audit.requirements: Claude Code, the hivemill-spend plugin and readable local Claude session logs.

skill:hivemill/setup.summary: Guide Claude Code through the Hivemill installation.
skill:hivemill/setup.use_when: Set up a factory using the installer rather than assembling its services manually.
skill:hivemill/setup.requirements: A fresh Debian or Ubuntu host and a logged-in Claude Code. The installer guide documents the remaining dependencies.

skill:hm-clean.summary: Planned tools for deterministic factory resource cleanup.
skill:hm-clean.use_when: Inspect the resource-hygiene proposal and implementation status.
